end.parentNote: Asha used a cat-and-doorbell example and then asked Tara to frame a salt-water investigation. Tara proposed a conditional prediction and described measuring plain and salt water before comparing them. Tara still said that theories become laws when fully proven, and this mix-up was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Tara to sort a few statements into observation, hypothesis, law or theory and explain why.
